text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky made a safe debut.
However, the reception right after the race was...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Seiun Sky definitely catches my eye, but...
It's still hard to tell whether she's truly strong or not."

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: If it's about my classmates, I should prioritize prepping against the others. Man, this year's competition is tough...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I bet names like Spe-chan and
Grass-chan are dancing around in their head right now~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she made her debut in the rain, Special Week showed a powerful run,
becoming a standout prospect among her generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, Grass Wonder, acclaimed as 'The Second Coming of the Monster'
and regarded as the strongest in the Junior Class.
This year's newcomers are packed with exceptional talent across the board.
choice_data_list: In terms of attention, we're losing to those two.
We're losing to those two when it comes to attention, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "In terms of" attention... right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because it feels just right. For Sei-chan, this is the perfect amount of spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I need everyone to achieve even greater success from now on and cast their shadows over me to keep me hidden."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll just stay snug and cozy in there♪
and build up my strength~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Stay calm and collected. The "big catch" we're aiming for
isn't going anywhere~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky's eyes glint sharply.
It seems she plans to bide her time and sharpen her claws in the Junior class. In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's build up experience in races where you have a good shot at winning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that our upcoming schedule?
B-By the way... is resting an option?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~?
Well, I guess I really do have to race~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, 'a race you can win,' huh...
You make it sound so easy, but it's really tough, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I don't get a reward every time I win,
I might not survive the grind~. *glance*
choice_data_list: ...I'm putting a nap into the schedule!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that we'd take it easy
and pace ourselves through the Classic year races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzzzzz)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my phone... whoops.
Excuse me for a second.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Hello?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your voice is way too loud.
Yeah, yeah... sure, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, yeah, okay.
Alright, alright~ Okay, got it, see ya.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You startled me.
Seriously, you always do things out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My grandpa told me
congratulations on making my debut.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, she made such a huge fuss!
She only just made her debut, so it's a real headache."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, what a troublesome old man.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, Seiun Sky
seemed somehow pleased.
choice_data_list: You really love Seiun Sky, huh.
You really love Seiun Sky, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Sei-chan is a beloved Umamusume, after all! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's true he's loved, but
Grandpa has plenty of other reasons to be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "*Ahem*. Anything beyond this is classified. If you wish to know, please file an application with the proper authorities~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She dodged the question at the end...
but it was a moment that offered a glimpse
into a side of her I had never seen before.
